description: gld-1 — optimized 19-mer from α-gliadin NRR1 (the lead ISG); distal to the celiac 33-mer
gld-1A — gld-1 variant with all cysteines → alanine
gld-2 — single mutation of gld-1 (cationic R → Q) to reduce cationic charge
gld-3 — double mutation of gld-1 (two cationic residues → Q)
gld-4 — cognate ISG from wheat HMW glutenin subunit 12 (core of SEQ 12)
gld-4A — gld-4 variant with cysteines → alanine
